title: Cargo picked up en route
description: Rule 95.1: a transporting ship can pick up units from the system it started in, the active system and each system it moves through (the repo's engine implements it: crates/ti4-engine/src/transit.rs, CargoWindow::for_ship). The movement tray only listed cargo standing in the carrier's origin, so a carrier passing a system with friendly infantry could not be told to take them along. The tray now predicts the engine's route (breadth first, neighbours in id order, wormholes included), lists own infantry, mechs and fighters standing in the systems on it and plans the loads in the same batch; 95.5 (own command token in the passed system) and capacity still apply. Before shots are committed (taken from the base commit), after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- AT. Mechs: a mech is a ground force and uses one slot like infantry; the Argent Flight's Aerie Sentinel (argent_mech) rides free (engine hook MovementHooks::free_cargo), so it can be the fifth unit on a hold of four.

shots.heading: Before: only origin cargo
shots.caption: Carrier at #24, two infantry on Lazar in #30 (on the route to Mecatol Rex) and a fighter in its space: the tray offers only the infantry at the origin, nothing from #30.

shots.heading: After: infantry staged from #30
shots.caption: Two infantry on Lazar (#30, on the way) and a fighter in #30's space are carryable; two infantry are staged. Commit sends Move, Load, Load, Done loading, Done moving as one batch.

shots.heading: Before: command token on #30
shots.caption: Same board with the player's command token in #30: nothing is offered from there.

shots.heading: After: command token on #30 (95.5)
shots.caption: Fighters and ground forces cannot be picked up from a system with their faction's command token other than the active system, so the tray still offers only the origin cargo.

shots.heading: Mech beside infantry, en route
shots.caption: A mech and three infantry on Lazar in #30 (on the way) fill the carrier's four slots; the fourth infantry is no longer offered. Commit sends Move, Load x4, Done moving as one batch.

shots.heading: Before: Argent mech counted as a slot
shots.caption: Four infantry fill the hold of four and the Argent Aerie Sentinel stays disabled, although the engine would carry it free.

shots.heading: After: Argent mech rides free
shots.caption: The same four infantry plus the Aerie Sentinel are staged (the gauge still reads 4 of 4); the batch sends five Loads, since the engine keeps a full hold open to free riders.
